source.snippet: Tell HN: Firebase service causing iOS crashes across many apps. Seems like a server-side change. (7 points, captured 2026-09-29) — referenced GitHub issue firebase-ios-sdk#16728 confirming widespread impact across many production apps.

problem_statement: Mobile app developers using Firebase have no early-warning or fallback system when Firebase server-side changes silently break production iOS apps across many customers simultaneously, leaving teams scrambling reactively.
target_segment: Mobile app developers and indie iOS/app studio operators relying on Firebase for backend services
notes: 7 points on HN with multiple apps affected simultaneously — clear business pain for teams with paying users. Buyer signal: companies paying Firebase bills and losing revenue from crashes. Adjacent opportunity: dependency health monitoring / canary alerting for third-party SDKs in mobile apps.
